problem: Which of the following is a representation of the set $S=N\times R$ in the Cartesian plane?

feedback.problem: Let $I=[0,1]⊂R$ and ${X}_{i}={i}\times [0,{i}^{2}].$ Which of the following represents ${⋂}_{i\in I}{X}_{i}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that the intersection of a family of indexed sets consists of those elements that belong to *all* the sets:

$$
{⋂}_{i\in I}{A}_{i}={x\,:\,x\in {A}_{k}\,\,\text{for all}\,\,k\in I}
$$

Let's now write down one of our indexed sets. For example, if $i=1,$ we have

$$
{X}_{1}={1}\times [0,{1}^{2}]={(1,k)\,:\,k\in [0,1]}.
$$

This represents a vertical line segment from the point $(1,0)$ to the point $(1,1)$ in the coordinate plane, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14094658/assets/6b6a47e464623fe9c572a52f7c71377136e68f41dcfd641920634b415568d7f5.png)

In general,

$$
{X}_{i}={i}\times [0,{i}^{2}]={(i,{k}^{2})\,:\,k\in [0,i]}
$$

is the vertical line segment from the point $(i,0)$ to the point $(i,{i}^{2}).$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14094658/assets/c67cd0b545f0fc779d2977e38fab8164eb3b0161a18e32a615c71d88d1c30b68.png)

There are no points that lie in all sets. Therefore, the intersection of the indexed sets is $∅,$ the empty set.
